title: 4. Trust: binding the page to its record

sections.name: model
sections.label: The model
sections.content: The PDF's XMP records the payload name, repository id, composition id, the archive's sha256, the sha256 of the rendered text and the engine version. The reader finds the payload through /AF, checks the archive checksum, validates, re-renders the composition and compares.

sections.name: tests
sections.label: What was tested
sections.content:
- Original: all checks pass.
- Record edited after printing, archive swapped in: fails on the archive checksum and on the re-render.
- The same, with the archive checksum also rewritten: still fails on the re-render, because the record no longer produces the printed text.
- qpdf --linearize: survives.
- Ghostscript re-distill (pdfwrite): the attachment and all XMP are stripped, silently.

sections.name: limits
sections.label: Limits
sections.content: A forger who edits the record and rewrites both checksums passes. Only a signature over the whole PDF closes that; a PDF signature covers the attachment too. Re-rendering as a check depends on deterministic rendering across engine versions, which is why the engine version is in the binding. PDF/A-3 conformance has not been checked with veraPDF.
